criteria.label: Pain quantified
criteria.definition: The customer states what a problem costs them in time, money, headcount or accuracy. A complaint with no size is not enough.

criteria.label: Current process known
criteria.definition: The customer describes how the work is done today — the tools, the steps or who does it.

criteria.label: Desired outcome stated
criteria.definition: The customer says what they want instead, either as a request or by describing how they would like it to work.

criteria.label: Timeline stated
criteria.definition: The customer names a date, deadline or period for the change they are considering. Scheduling the next meeting does not count.

criteria.label: Budget indicated
criteria.definition: The customer refers to budget, funding, price sensitivity or when money can be committed.
